import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Simple approach: use top features by effect size
    effects = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] == 'expression' or feats.types[i] == 'clinical':
            # Effect size: difference in means between outcome groups
            mean1 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, i])
            mean0 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, i])
            effect = abs(mean1 - mean0)
            effects.append((fid, effect))
    
    # Sort by effect size and take top 5
    effects.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    drivers = [fid for fid, _ in effects[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Use all features for columns
    columns = list(feats.ids)
    
    # Only include products for strongly correlated pairs (|r| >= 0.7)
    products = set()
    X = feats.x
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(feats.ids):
        for j, fid2 in enumerate(feats.ids[i+1:], i+1):
            corr = np.corrcoef(X[:, i], X[:, j])[0, 1]
            if abs(corr) >= 0.7:
                products.add((fid1, fid2))
    
    # Simple loadings based on effect sizes
    loadings = {}
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        mean1 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, i])
        mean0 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, i])
        loadings[fid] = mean1 - mean0
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
